_comment: REFERENCE ONLY — no webhook receiver is shipped in v1. This file documents the payload shape a future receiver would consume so teams who want to build one have a starting point. Replace the values with real data from your SonarQube webhook configuration.

tlctc_extension._comment: Proposed extension: the receiver invokes tlctc-sonar classify against this project and posts cluster_summary back to a downstream system (Slack, Jira, etc.).
